description: This file contains unit tests for exception safety of absl::variant, including various constructors, assignment operators, emplace, and swap, specifically testing exception guarantees and variant states after exceptions.

classes.name: ThrowingValue
classes.description: A testing utility class that throws exceptions during copy/move operations to simulate exception safety scenarios.

classes.name: ThrowingAllocator
classes.description: A custom allocator used in testing to simulate exceptions during memory allocation.

methods.name: ToValuelessByException
methods.description: Function to force a variant into the valueless by exception state.

methods.name: VariantInvariants
methods.description: Checks that the variant maintains invariants after operations, especially after exceptions.

methods.name: ExpectedThrower
methods.description: Creates a Thrower object with optional arguments for testing.

methods.name: ExpectedThrowerVec
methods.description: Returns a vector of Thrower objects for testing.

methods.name: ValuelessByException
methods.description: Creates a variant in the valueless by exception state.

methods.name: WithThrower
methods.description: Returns a variant containing a Thrower object.

methods.name: WithThrowerVec
methods.description: Returns a variant containing a vector of Thrower objects.

methods.name: WithCopyNoThrow
methods.description: Returns a variant with a copy-only ThrowingValue that does not throw.

methods.name: WithMoveNoThrow
methods.description: Returns a variant with a move-only ThrowingValue that does not throw.
